work_scope.capability: Existing browser visual source feeding GPT Live context
work_scope.reaction_timescale: Browser picker and source registration completion
work_scope.authority_owner: Existing account controls and user-selected browser source

review: Separated the captured non-null source identity and active stream from the nullable stream reference used for failure cleanup. The ended-track callback retains the exact registered source; audio registration and attachment retain the active stream.

The missing-stream guard reports an explicit internal capture error before dereferencing a null stream. Valid media results already require a stream; this is defensive validation, not a newly proven user-visible runtime failure.

Five mounted-hook cases passed before and after the refactor: completed capture followed by track end, cancellation before late media, unmount before late source registration, tab audio attachment and detach, and denied media. The initial diagnostic run lacked jsdom and is not a regression baseline.

Existing source-media helpers, toolbar and Live Vision coordination tests are selected unchanged. Media, source registration, frame production and store attachment are synthetic. No live capture or external provider was used.
limits: Local source/type qualification only. Browser permission behavior, actual frames/audio and installed GPT Live Minecraft continuity remain unverified here.
Standalone display-audio picker cancellation and other unselected source/room operations are outside these checks. Public source and download publication remain pending.
